beats.event: Reaping day in District 12; Prim's name is drawn
Katniss volunteers as tribute in Prim's place
Peeta Mellark chosen as District 12's male tribute
Whisked to Capitol; meets Haymitch, Effie, Cinna
Cinna's flaming costume makes her 'the Girl on Fire'
Earns the top private training score from Gamemakers
Peeta declares love on TV; framed as 'star-crossed lovers'
Cornucopia bloodbath; Katniss flees into the woods
Gamemakers' wall of fire drives her toward the Careers
Drops tracker jacker nest on Careers; wins a bow
Allies with Rue, the young tribute from District 11
She and Rue destroy the Careers' stockpile of supplies
Rue is speared; Katniss covers her body in flowers
District 11 sends her bread in gratitude
Rule change: two tributes from one district may win together
Finds Peeta camouflaged by the stream; hides and nurses him
Feast: Clove attacks her, Thresh spares her for Rue's sake
Sponsor medicine reaches Peeta and saves his life
Mutt wolves chase them; Katniss mercy-kills mauled Cato
Rule reversed; she and Peeta ready nightlock berries to die together
Gamemakers relent and declare both joint victors
Return to District 12 as victors; Haymitch warns Capitol is furious
